parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: correct unsimplified first two terms of (1 − 2x)^(1/2), e.g. 1 + (1/2)(−2x) = 1 − x; symbolic coefficients alone are insufficient. B1: correct unsimplified x² term, e.g. [(1/2)(−1/2)/2!](−2x)² = −x²/2; symbolic coefficients alone are insufficient. M1: obtain sufficient terms of the product with (3 + x) through x². A1: 3 − 2x − (5/2)x². [Total: 4]
